name: krexa
description: Turn a trading idea, post or video into fixed rules, backtest and paper-trade them, and request a live trading agent that you approve and sign. Connects to Krexa's hosted MCP server; the key cannot move or withdraw funds.

krexa_agent_key.title: Krexa agent key
krexa_agent_key.description: Your Krexa key (starts with kxm_). Get it at https://krexa.xyz/mcp/link. It can research, backtest, paper-trade, pause agents and request deploys; it cannot move or withdraw money.
